ios.desc:
How loud is it, really?

TooLoud turns your iPhone into a simple sound level meter, so you can see at a glance whether the place you're in is loud enough to damage your hearing.

Your ears start to take damage above 85 dB — a busy street, a blender, a noisy restaurant — often without you noticing. TooLoud shows the volume around you in real time and warns you when it's worth reaching for ear protection.

FEATURES

• Live decibel readings — current, average and peak levels at a glance
• A clear, colour-coded meter: green when you're safe, red when you're not
• “How loud is that?” — a reference guide that maps everyday sounds, from a whisper to a concert, onto the decibel scale, with your own reading pinned in place
• Adjustable smoothing to filter out sudden spikes for a steadier average
• A clean, distraction-free design

TooLoud gives guideline readings using your device's built-in microphone, and it's a great way to build awareness of the noise in your daily life.

Protect your hearing — it doesn't grow back.

quotes.text:
I taught myself Objective-C for fun last summer, then one day decided to release an app. I spent about 3 hours coding then about a day sorting out code signing, artwork, submission etc. As a result of that weekend I've ended up getting a pretty nice side income from advertisements from the free version and straight revenue from the paid version.  In fairness, since releasing it I've quite considerably improved the application but its still less than 800 lines of code.
